shortBio: Longfall is a cinematic alt-rock band from Minneapolis/St Paul.
fullBio: With an emphasis on storytelling they lean into well-crafted lyrics and wide ranging sonic pallet to guide listeners through an emotional musical experience. A single musical number may diverge from a waltz to ambient interlude to hip hop infused bridge and supported by R&B melodies. Longfall's genre bending is all in support of thematic detours within the musical journey.
notableHighlights: Reuniting to release a new album 'Idols' - 5 years in the making!
Looking to launch the album in early 2027

pressQuotes.quote: Longfall makes fragile, grandiose, soundscape rock, with a sweeping epic feel enabled and undercut by how often they interrupt or redirect their seeping electronic groove.
pressQuotes.author: Lucas Fagen,

stagePlotNotes: 4-piece band 4 monitor mixes, 1 center keys vocal (through vocal processor which also handles sax), & 1 guitar vocal. Stereo in for keyboard, stereo in for laptop, mics for 2 guitar amps, DI for Bass, mics for 4 piece drumkit.
